# MockOps

> MockOps is a WireMock API management console: a static single-page React
> app that manages one or more WireMock servers — mappings, the request
> journal, near misses, scenarios, recordings, `__files`, global settings —
> entirely through WireMock's Admin API, called directly from the browser.
> It has no backend of its own.

MockOps is open source. This file follows the https://llmstxt.org
convention to help AI tools and coding agents find the canonical
documentation quickly. See `/llms-full.txt` on this site for every page
concatenated into one plain-text document.
